visits.title: Cough, how long and what to take

turns.speaker: patient
turns.english: I have had this cough for three weeks and chest pain when I breathe.
turns.text: Qufaa kana torban sadiif qaba, yeroon hafuura baafadhus dhukkubbii qomaa qaba.

turns.english: She has had this cough for three weeks and chest pain when she breathes.

turns.speaker: provider
turns.english: Take two puffs of the inhaler every eight hours for seven days. If the chest pain gets worse, come back today.
